text:
chelsea: Kickoff for SaffronAI onboarding. They sent model artifacts and propose a three-tier listing: hosted, partner-hosted (proxy), and geo-gated download. Need legal/export + ops checklist.
hiro: clarify geo-gated download: customers in allowed regions can download weights after signing MSA + attestation?
amanda: yes. partner wants to block downloads to embargoed countries and offer partner-hosted for those regions instead. Also asking for an enterprise-only license SKU.
partner-saffron: we'll provide signed weights tar, cosign container, OpenKey v3 provenance, and an attestation template. Prefer download_restricted with per-customer KMS key wrap.
legal-bot: marketplace policy requires an explicit redistribution flag: "no-download", "download-restricted", or "download-sublicensable". For download_restricted we need customer attestation wording + warranty of non-infringement or an insurance binder.
export-bot: export note: NL-origin models need classification for ECCN or equivalent. Attach export paperwork or we'll block certain geos.
hiro: ops questions: remote-proxy path needs health endpoint + billing webhook. Downloadable SKU needs metadata: download_allowed, attestation_url, kms_requirement, geo_allowlist.
amanda: marketing asked about embargo and co-announce cadence. Partner prefers 10 business days after contract signoff, and wants joint blog + partner quote. Are logo approvals automated?
legal-bot: logo and quote require written approval stored with PR package. We'll need partner signoff at least 72h before publish.
partner-saffron: we'll do 72h turnaround. Also requesting a rev-share table for SI-managed installs: 70/30 partner/redwood for SI management, 60/40 for downloads, 85/15 for hosted. Is that in-scope?
chelsea: finance will need appendices and audit rights. Legal: any blockers with the proposed splits?
legal-bot: rev-share is negotiable, but finance needs reporting granularity and an audit clause. We'll also evaluate indemnity cap; partner proposes capping to insurer limits. Provide insurer binder.
export-bot: opened ticket EX-6122 to assess export lists. Target initial reply: 72h.
hiro: ops checklist snippet I need:
```
- model_name: saffron-7B
- version: 2026-07-12
- artifacts: [weights.tar.gz, runner.cosign.sig, manifest.pgp]
- quantizations: [fp16, int8-quant]
- download_allowed: download-restricted
- attestation_url: https://partner/saffron/attest.pdf
- kms_requirement: per_customer_wrap
- geo_allowlist: ["US","EU","UK"]
- telemetry: aggregated_only
- proxy_health: https://partner/healthz
- billing_webhook: https://partner/billing/hook
```
amanda: product note: we should publish a model card summarizing training data provenance and known limitations. Partner agreed to a short model card but asked that certain internal training details remain private. That's fine as long as provenance and safety notes are public.
partner-saffron: we'll provide a model card draft and the PGP-signed manifest by Tue EOD.
chelsea: timeline proposal:
- Tue: partner uploads insurer binder + signed manifest + model card draft
- Wed: export-control and legal initial review (EX-6122 + PL-6123)
- Thu: ops create staging tiles with canary proxy route and blocked download flag until legal clears
- Two weeks after partner signoff: publish + co-announce per embargo
ops-bot: I'll create staging tile and mark downloadable SKU as blocked until legal flips the flag. Will enable canary routing for partner-hosted path.
legal-bot: opening PL-6123 for indemnity/rev-share and attaching checklist. Please add insurer binder to the ticket.
hiro: I'll add the inference profile to staging once we have the quantization details.
amanda: I'll draft the co-announcement copy and share in this thread for partner review.
partner-saffron: we'll aim to provide binder + attestation by Tue EOD and review marketing copy within 48h.
chelsea: action items recap:
- @partner-saffron: upload insurer binder, PGP manifest, model card draft by Tue
- @legal-bot: review indemnity/rev-share and confirm logo/quote approvals (PL-6123)
- @export-bot: export classification check (EX-6122)
- @ops-bot: staging tile + canary proxy; gate downloadable SKU
- @hiro: staging inference profile + quantization verification
- @amanda: draft co-announce and model card redlines
If anything blocks, call it out here and we'll escalate. Thanks! :sparkles:
